outlet: Washington Supreme Court, No. 105320-7, Ruling Denying Stay (Deputy Commissioner, May 5, 2026)
notes: Nowels et al. v. State: the sheriffs of Spokane, Pend Oreille, Stevens and Ferry (Ray Maycumber, in his individual and official capacity) are respondents challenging the sheriff-qualification and removal provisions of SSSB 5974 (Laws of 2026, ch. 258); Thurston County Superior Court granted a preliminary injunction on April 29, 2026, and the ruling denies the State's motion to stay it.
